info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Retrieval API
info.description: The Loan Application Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information regarding specific loan applications within the system. This endpoint is crucial for stakeholders, such as loan officers and applicants, who need to track the status and details of their loan requests. By providing comprehensive data about individual applications, this API enhances transparency and facilitates informed decision-making. Use cases include reviewing application history, verifying submission statuses, and managing client inquiries effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve a loan application by its unique identifier.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the details of a specific loan application using its unique ID. The response will include all relevant information related to the loan application, enabling users to review its status and pertinent details.
